create_LogProgress_wrapper: create a LogProgress wrapper to log progress updates for an iterable with configurable frequency
use_LogProgress_update: use LogProgress update method to pass custom metrics like loss or accuracy during iteration
setup_dora_logging: setup dora logging with optional verbose mode to enable DEBUG level output to stderr
disable_dora_logging: disable dora logging by removing the stream handler from the dora logger
use_fatal_exit: use the fatal function to print a bold FATAL message to stderr and exit with code 1
